blocks.html: [[a href="/hours-location/"]]Briargrove Eye Center[[/a]] offers a full range of eye health services to our patients, from children to older adults. We offer [[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-exams/"]]routine eye exams[[/a]] and vision tests, eye disease diagnosis and management, immediate attention for eye emergencies, and complete eye health management. We use the latest technology to ensure your eye health.
Dr. Muldoon provides eyewear prescriptions and offers corrective laser eye surgery co-management as well. Please be in touch with our office to schedule an appointment.

We are proud to provide eye care for the neighboring community of Tanglewood, and we are located near the Galleria mall, a main attraction in Houston, TX. In addition to comprehensive vision services, we also offer aesthetic treatments, including [[a href="/eye-care-services/latisse/"]]eyelash treatment[[/a]] options, to help patients look and feel their best.
